title: Manual surge deconflict roster and quick-scan (April 2032)
content:
Purpose:
This is an ad-hoc, minimal spreadsheet used to deconflict manual surge coverage across regions for the Apr 2–8 maintenance window and the unexpected traffic bump on Apr 3. Use for fast decisions only — do not treat as canonical.

Table: regional manual coverage snapshot (live notes)
Columns: Region | Primary owner | Backup owner | Coverage window (UTC) | Expected peak QPS | Notes / blockers | Action (owner)
NA | Marcus Lee | Priya Shah | 20232-04-02 06:00 - 20232-04-03 06:00 | 120 | regional infra patch + canary; need DB read-only toggle tested | Marcus to validate DB toggle (JIRA-OPS-4521)
EU | Owen Brooks | Clara Nguyen | 20232-04-02 14:00 - 20232-04-03 14:00 | 85 | CDN edge purge scheduled; watch 503s | Owen to escalate to CDN partner if 503 > 1%
APAC | Mei Tanaka | Aarav Patel | 20232-04-03 00:00 - 20232-04-04 00:00 | 160 | unexpected traffic spike observed Apr 3 02:30 UTC; autoscale lagging | Mei to open hotfix PR for autoscaler timeout (PR: runtime#987)
LATAM | Sofia Ribeiro | Marcus Lee | 20232-04-02 10:00 - 20232-04-02 22:00 | 40 | low, but single-instance risk (maintenance on host-7) | Sofia to move critical routes off host-7 pre-window
EMEA-EDGE | Priya Shah | Owen Brooks | 20232-04-02 16:00 - 20232-04-03 04:00 | 30 | edge metric sparsity — rely on fallback model variant | Priya to enable fallback mapping for route /v1/generate

Quick total row (scripty): 120+85+160+40+30 = ~435 QPS peak projected across surge windows (conservative).

Shortnotes / runbook snippets (raw):
- If API 5xx rate > 0.5% for any region for 3 consecutive minutes, flip per-route fallback to smaller model (route-level config: fallback_variant=base-quant). Owner on-call to post status in #ops-surges and tag oncall-rotation.
- DB read-only toggle: CLI toggle: infractl db set-mode --cluster prod-readonly --confirm. Confirmed working in staging (Marcus).
- Autoscaler hotfix: increase gracePeriod to 45s for APAC GPU pools. Mei to land PR and coordinate short restart (expect 45m).

Open questions / decisions needed (short):
- Can Dedicated pool for SE-1 be temporarily borrowed for APAC peak? (cost ok for 6h but needs approval). Owner: Clara (ask acct mgmt).
- Should we shift non-critical background jobs to maintenance window to lower load? (low friction) Owner: Sofia to confirm with batch team.

Action tracker (single-line items):
- Marcus: Validate DB toggle in prod-like by 04-02 18:00 UTC.
- Mei: PR for autoscaler timeout + restart checklist by 04-03 01:00 UTC.
- Owen: Monitor CDN 503 rate and escalate to partner after 3min sustained >1%.
- Priya: Update route fallback map and confirm on canary for EMEA-edge by 04-02 20:00 UTC.
- Clara: Check Dedicated pool borrowing feasibility and report by 04-03 08:00 UTC.

Lightweight decision log (for handoff) — append-only:
- 04-02 09:12 UTC (Clara): Approved EMEA fallback mapping change; noted potential small latency increase but prevents 5xx.
- 04-03 02:45 UTC (Mei): Observed APAC spike; autoscaler lag 30s -> scheduled hotfix deployment 03:30 UTC.

Slack threads / quick links referenced:
- slack://threads/C01234ABCD  (ops-surges thread)
- JIRA-OPS-4521 (DB toggle validation ticket)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987 (autoscaler hotfix draft)

Notes to readers:
- This file intentionally short-lived; snapshot once surge is over and paste key decisions to Confluence (confluence://ops/surge-postmortems).
- If you edit the table, add an "edited_by: NAME @ YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC" line below the action tracker so change owners are auditable.

Quick checklist before closing surge:
- [ ] Confirm 5xx rate < 0.1% for 60 minutes regionally
- [ ] Autoscaler restart successful in APAC (health checks green)
- [ ] All temporary route fallbacks reverted or pinned in config
- [ ] Postmortem stub created in Confluence

Rough cost note: borrowing Dedicated pool SE-1 for 6h estimated cost ~$2.2k (nominal) — Clara to confirm with finance.
